name: al-objid-ninja
description: Checks for untracked AL object IDs against the Ninja backend
author: Vjeko.com

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory to scan for AL apps (`app.json`). Leave empty to use the default sources directory (`Build.SourcesDirectory`). If your pipeline checks the repository out to a custom location via the `checkout` step's `path` parameter, set this to the same value. Relative paths are resolved against `Agent.BuildDirectory`; absolute paths are used as-is.

inputs.name: excludeFieldIds
inputs.label: Exclude field IDs
inputs.helpMarkDown: Skip checking table/table extension field IDs

inputs.name: excludeEnumValueIds
inputs.label: Exclude enum value IDs
inputs.helpMarkDown: Skip checking enum/enum extension value IDs
